sections.Profile:
"4 Roses" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in December 1962. Designed by Steve Kordek, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, eleven rollover buttons, two gobble holes, and a rotating target. The backglass artwork, created by George Molentin, showcases a pageantry theme.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
